paragraphs.text: Windows boot autostart bundle plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): registers the app into HKCU Run on
enable, removes it on disable.
# dsh-autostart
开机自启动插件 for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) on Windows.
启用本插件后，dsh 会把自身注册到当前用户的 Windows 登录自启动项；禁用后自动移除。
When the plugin is enabled, it registers the DeepSeek Harness executable in the current user's Windo
ws logon autostart entry; disabling the plugin removes it again.
## What it does
| Action | Effect |
| 启用 Enable | Writes `DeepSeekHarnessAutoStart` into `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion

\Run` pointing at the running `process.execPath` (correctly quoted for paths with spaces). |
| 禁用 /

卸载 Disable / uninstall | Removes that registry value. |
| Non-Windows platforms | No-op — the plugin
logs that autostart is only supported on Windows. |
Only the current user's hive (`HKCU`) is touched, so **no administrator privileges are required**, a
nd everything is undone on disable.
## Requirements

- Windows (the plugin is inert elsewhere)
- A DeepSeek Harness profile with plugin/bundle support
## Install
> The npm name `dsh-autostart` is already taken by a different project, so install from this reposit
ory (Option A or B). See Prior art below.
### Option A — Plugin Manager / dshmarket
If your dsh plugin market can install bundles from a Git repository, point it at this repo, then ena
ble the `dsh-autostart` row.
### Option B — Clone and link the checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart dsh.
## Verify
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Expected (quotes are required — the install path contains spaces):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Note: the autostart entry launches dsh at **Windows logon**, not at dsh restart. To test, sign out a
nd back in (or reboot).
## How it works
`index.js` is a Cordis host plugin (`export function apply(ctx, config)`):
- On activation it runs `reg add` via `execFileSync` (no shell, so the quoting around the spaced pat

h survives).
- Cleanup is registered with `ctx.effect`. Cordis runs the `ctx.effect` callback **imme
diately** and treats its **return value** as the disposer — so the delete lives in the returned func
tion and only fires on real disable/unload.
## Uninstall
Disable the plugin (or `remove_bundle`), which deletes the registry value. Nothing else is written.
## Prior art
`dsh-autostart` on npm (Ghost011118/dsh-autostart) is a separate project that solves an adjacent pro
blem: it autostarts **`dsh web`** with a hidden window and a crash-restart supervisor. This plugin i
nstead registers the **desktop app** itself through the standard Windows logon Run key, driven by ds
h's own plugin enable/disable, and writes nothing beyond a single `HKCU` value.
